title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency for RBAC v2 policies and add audit events for KMS key binding and policy violation. Includes migration to annotate existing policies and documentation. Backwards-compatible guardrails; rollout gate via feature flag.
description: Motivation: customers in regulated environments require strict data residency controls for customer-managed keys and KMS-backed secrets. This PR updates RBAC v2 policy evaluation to enforce KMS region residency constraints, surfaces detailed audit events when a request would violate a residency constraint, and provides a migration for existing policies. Summary of changes: 1) Policy evaluator: validate kms_key.region against resource residency constraints and policy-level kms_region_pinning attribute; 2) Audit logging: emit kms_region_binding and kms_region_violation events with key metadata and matched policy id; 3) Migration: add a one-time job to annotate policies that reference KMS keys missing explicit region pin settings and mark them as audit-only until owner confirms; 4) Config: new feature flag security.enforce_kms_region_residency (default disabled) and rollout plan to flip per-tenant; 5) Tests: unit, integration, and e2e tests added; 6) Docs: updated RBAC v2 spec and migration guide. Backwards compatibility: when feature flag is off the system only emits audit events; when on it enforces policy. Rollout: enable audit-only for all customers for 2 weeks, contact owners for manual confirmation, then enable enforcement for tenants with confirmed policies. Related work: ENG-4312, SEC-88, SUP-4512.

b4d5e6f audit: add kms_region_binding and kms_region_violation events
c7e8f90 migration: annotate existing policies missing kms region pinning
d1a2b3c tests: add unit and integration tests for kms residency checks
e4f5a6b docs: update rbac v2 spec and migration guide
diff_snippets: --- a/services/authorization/rbac_v2/policy_evaluator.py +++ b/services/authorization/rbac_v2/policy_evaluator.py @@ def evaluate(policy, resource): +    # validate KMS key region pinning +    if policy.kms_region_pinning: +        if resource.kms_key.region != policy.kms_region_pinning: +            emit_audit('kms_region_violation', {...}) +            return DENY if flags.enforce_kms_region_residency else AUDIT

--- a/services/authorization/rbac_v2/audit_events.py +++ b/services/authorization/rbac_v2/audit_events.py @@ def emit(event_type, payload): +    if event_type == 'kms_region_binding': +        payload.update({'kms_key_id': key.id, 'kms_region': key.region, 'policy_id': policy.id}) +    enqueue_audit(payload)

--- a/migrations/2026_02_20_annotate_kms_region_pinning.py +++ b/migrations/2026_02_20_annotate_kms_region_pinning.py @@ def migrate(): +    for policy in policies: +        if references_kms_key(policy) and not policy.kms_region_pinning: +            policy.annotations['kms_region_pinning_audit'] = True +            save(policy)
